mapper.select: SELECT id, alarm_id, dispatch_rule_id, recipient_id, recipient_name, recipient_phone, channel, title, content, status, send_time, error_msg, create_time FROM alarm_notification WHERE alarm_id = #{alarmId} ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm_notification (alarm_id, dispatch_rule_id, recipient_id, recipient_name, recipient_phone, channel, title, content, status, create_time) VALUES (#{alarmId}, #{dispatchRuleId}, #{recipientId}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{channel}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{createTime})
